No live class

A big leap with no first step

From a reel, the options are a $77 workshop or a 1:1 application. There’s no free hour where someone feels what working with you is like before they apply.

Too many doors

Every link sits side by side

Your links page puts the workshop, the 1:1 application, the Denver meetup, the 90-minute session and discount codes next to each other. Nothing tells a new follower which one is for them, or tells you who’s ready.

Reach

Growth waits for a reel to break out

Your pinned reels reached 153k to 315k views. Your last 7 ranged from 4k to 33.8k, and six of the seven stayed under 14k. In a quiet week, far fewer people ever hear about the offer.

The high achievers who are ready to stop settling are already watching your reels. There’s no moment yet that lets them raise their hand.

My recommendation

A free live class, The Good Enough Trap, that turns reel viewers into sign-ups and finds your next 1:1 clients

You already have a $77 workshop, so the class itself should be free. The workshop moves to the thank-you page, earns from day one and helps pay for the ads, and the class gives people a full hour with you before they apply.

Does this sound like you?

Good on paper. Good enough everywhere else.

  • From the outside it all looks fine: the career, the plans, the photos.
  • You can explain exactly what’s wrong, and it still doesn’t change.
  • “It’s fine” has become your answer to things that aren’t.
  • You’re done talking about change. You want the capacity to actually do it.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in one hour

What the Good Enough Trap is

Why high achievers are often the ones who settle, and why it’s so easy to miss when everything looks fine from the outside.

How to spot your own settling style

The patterns that keep you choosing “good enough”, and how to notice yours in real time.

Your behavioural leaks

Where your time and energy quietly drain away, and why naming them is the first step.

Out of your head, into your body

Why thinking harder about change rarely creates it, and what to do instead.

Building the capacity for change

Most people talk about change. Here’s how to start building the capacity for it, so a reinvention actually sticks.

Meet Alexis

Hi, I’m Alexis Doss

Most people talk about change. I build the capacity for it.

I’m a Higher Standards Coach. I help high performers identify their behavioural leaks and get out of their heads and into their bodies, so they can radically reinvent themselves.

I talk about grief, healthy communication and reinvention, and I’m living my own reinvention right now: I’m quitting my job to pursue music. This class is where I show you how the Good Enough Trap works, and how to step out of it.

Script 1 · “Good on paper”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The people who settle the most are often the ones who look like they have it all together.”

Body

“Great job. Great plans. Great photos. And a quiet list of things they’ve decided are ‘fine’. That’s the Good Enough Trap, and high achievers are the best at hiding it, even from themselves.”

CTA

“I’m running a free live class on how it works and how to step out of it. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, moss backdrop, bold white caps captions.

Script 2 · “Talk vs capacity”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most people talk about change. Very few build the capacity for it.”

Body

“You can know exactly what needs to change and still not do it. That’s not a willpower problem. It’s capacity. In this class I’ll show you how to spot your behavioural leaks and get out of your head and into your body.”

CTA

“The class is free and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: walk-and-talk outdoors, natural light, voice to camera.

Script 3 · “It’s fine”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“When was the last time you said ‘it’s fine’ and actually meant it?”

Body

“‘Fine’ is where a lot of high achievers stop asking for more. Not because they don’t want more, but because good enough feels safer than choosing. I call it the Good Enough Trap.”

CTA

“Join me live in The Good Enough Trap. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera with three on-screen text cards: Spot it · Name it · Step out of it.
